limitations: Exact architectural plans, floor-to-floor dimensions, roof slopes and mechanical arrangement were unavailable; these are informed estimates.

GIS Shape__Area is 6084.586 in the source field but the transformed WGS84 ring area is 3520.26 square meters; source field units/method are undocumented, so the footprint geometry itself was used and this discrepancy remains open.
The GIS shell polygon is generalized and does not provide verified courtyard, wall thickness or roof-height evidence; compare the footprint top-down before replacing the original massing.
The Google Street View source is dated 2018 for Clinic Drive and March 2026 for Harrison Street; facade match is strong but portions are occluded and branch/corner attribution is approximate.
The interior is schematic; modeled cues include reception, fitness equipment, audiology sound booth and clinic exam table, but room layouts are not detailed construction plans.
